-- Advances the generator state. Keeps the state in [0, 2147483647).
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  post out >= 0
  (s * 16807) % 2147483647

-- Swaps two elements of a list in place.
swap_at(var xs: List[int], i: int, j: int) =
  pre i >= 0
  pre j >= 0
  pre i < xs.len()
  pre j < xs.len()
  let a = xs[i]
  xs[i] = xs[j]
  xs[j] = a

-- Returns a permutation of xs chosen only by seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 1) == []
  ex shuffled([4], 9) == [4]
  var ys = copy xs
  var state = seed
  let n = xs.len()
  for k in range(0, n)
    let i = n - 1 - k
    state = next_state(state)
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    swap_at(&ys, i, j)
  ys
